facts.summary: Phase 3 trial missed primary endpoint, program paused · Phase 3 · OV101 (gaboxadol) in Angelman syndrome · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Ovid Therapeutics Announces Phase 3 NEPTUNE Clinical Trial of OV101 for the Treatment of Angelman Syndrome Did Not Meet Primary Endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint of the NEPTUNE study was not achieved.
evidence.safety: OV101 was well-tolerated, with no significant safety issues observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: OV101 program in Angelman syndrome to pause pending full analysis of NEPTUNE trial and discussions with FDA
